Excellent clinic. I have no words to express my gratitude, especially to Dr. Marta and nurse Catarina. I was able to keep my beloved Spartza for another year thanks to Dr. Marta's dedication. She tirelessly researched all the medications he was already taking (he was being followed holistically, using herbs, homeopathic remedies, among others). She was tireless and put together the best plan, always dedicated, very honest, efficient, direct, and professional. When I went to this clinic, my dog ​​was 14 years old and very ill; he was diagnosed with kidney failure. Thanks to the dedication of these excellent professionals, I was able to keep him with me for another year. I was very lucky to choose this clinic, and all my gratitude is insufficient. Later, I went back with a very unfortunate situation involving a kitten that wasn't mine. I cried a lot, and Dr. Marta showed great empathy. Even with a busy schedule, she supported me and said comforting words that I will never forget. Thank you so much ❤️
Thank you for your rating! 🙏🏻😃 …
The staff was very attentive, and the veterinarian who treated my cat was super professional.

Fantastic experience.
Friendly team.
I recommend it.

Very expensive! They treated me well and were friendly, but they even charged me for cutting my nails without warning, even though it takes me 1 minute to cut them at home. They charged for a consultation when she was already going to have surgery... in short... I thought it was all an exaggeration. 330 euros to remove a sebaceous cyst.
A very kind and extremely competent team. My dog ​​was spayed there, and they took great care of her and us.
Dr. Ruben is an excellent professional. The whole team is friendly. I recommend him.

I want to thank the Tantas Patas team for the care and attention they gave Leo. They were always very attentive and available, not only during the consultation but also in the post-consultation follow-up.

A very special thank you to Dr. Marta Carreira for the kindness, professionalism, and dedication with which she treated Leo. We were very satisfied with all the care. I recommend them without a doubt!
Veterinarians and technicians are always concerned and attentive, we love Dr. Marta! With a great bathing and grooming service.
Our animals (Verdi, Valentina and Júlio) are cared for at Tantas Patas and we are so grateful for all the care and availability they have for them and for us!
It's a veterinary clinic with highly qualified and knowledgeable doctors and nurses. Everyone is super friendly.

Extremely caring and warm professionals.
It's noticeable that there is genuine concern and attention during the service, not only for the animals but also for the owners. Special mention goes to Dr. Marta and Dr. Ruben and the entire nursing team who have been taking care of Samba with great care and patience from the beginning.

Easy to schedule appointments and vaccinations.
Highly recommend.
Words cannot describe how careful and attentive they are with our Best Friends!!! On behalf of Nara and Noa... THANK YOU 🐕🧡 …
The only problem with this clinic and spa is that afterwards it becomes difficult, or even impossible, to be as satisfied with any other :) The best. Soja and I loved it!

Impeccable! My children have been cared for, pampered, and nurtured for over 10 years by highly competent, responsible, committed, and loving professionals. They have been by my side and my children's side through the most difficult and happiest moments, with complete professionalism and humanity. There are no words to express how grateful I am! Thank you so much to everyone at the TANTAS PATAS Veterinary Center 🐾

The Tantas Patas team is absolutely impeccably professional. I have two dogs, one of whom is a senior dog with several health complications – some of which are unusual and difficult to diagnose. It was thanks to Dr. Marta that we were able to rule out these issues and bring more comfort to her golden years. Their support is tireless, always advising on what's best for the animal and also considering various options so that we can choose within our means and with knowledge. All pathologies and medications are explained in detail, and there is always room for hope. I owe this team the fact that my dog ​​is still with us, after the crises she went through that other clinics and hospitals had given up on.
From the very first consultation, our little dog Toddy has been treated with so much love and care. The veterinary team is simply top-notch! I recommend them 100%!

Goma really enjoys all the services and I always get answers to any questions I have about her health.
It's considered her second paradise. The first is our den. Hehe
As proof, I'm leaving a photo of her at the clinic.
5 suns to the entire Tantas Patas team
Congratulations

I don't know of any other place where I have more confidence than Tantas Patas. I'm a professional in the field and I had already been following the work of these professionals before I needed care for Ginja. When it came time to decide where to treat my 9-year-old dog, who had several associated health problems, I had no doubts in choosing Dr. Marta, Dr. Diana and the lovely nurses at Tantas Patas. They are transparent in everything they do and above all they are humane.

Ginja feels at home, relaxed, even in this environment that we so often associate with anxiety.
We continue to visit them from time to time for whatever comes up, but thanks to them, the worst is over.
All the professionals are very friendly and very good at what they do.
I can only express my gratitude for all the care Freddy has received since he was little; without a doubt, they are excellent professionals!

People need to start questioning how many times they take their pet to this veterinary center when it has a problem, only to leave with a temporary solution after spending a fortune, only to find themselves returning to the center countless times for the same problem that, magically, remains unresolved or even worsens. My question is: How many times have you been to this veterinary center for the same health problem with your pet, and how much do you spend each time? Why wasn't it resolved the first or second time?
Thank you for your rating! 😃 …

Very bad experience. Very arrogant, they don't address the problems, but drag them out to charge more and take advantage of people's lack of knowledge. The prices are absurd, the likes of which I've never seen - even the São Bento Veterinary Hospital, where I currently take my pet, and which is known for being more expensive, manages to be cheaper and the professionalism is 10/10.
TERRIBLE! Never, ever again. Terrible service, terrible care for the animal. Why do they have this profession if they don't like animals? A money-making machine?

Horrible. I'm not giving it a 0 because I can't. They don't let the owner in with the animal (I don't know why), I've been to so many vets because I've had several animals and this is the first one where not only will I never go back, but I'm going to tell everyone to never set foot there again. HORRIBLE.

We came to this vet in an emergency and move permanently. We are so happy we did and wish we had brought our boy here sooner! All the vets and staff are incredible and truly love animals. It’s clean and well equipped. The only issue is that parking can be very difficult, so come early.
Thank you for your feedback! :D

We really like this clinic; everyone is very professional and friendly. Dr. Marta is very attentive to our cat, Arroios. The clinic offers several services, which is very convenient. I highly recommend it.

Buba has had some health problems, and on all occasions, he was treated very well, and the problems were resolved. I trust all the doctors 100%!

We received excellent service from the very first phone call. The doctor was impeccable, very attentive and available. I live far from the clinic, but I intend to take my cats there from now on.

Bathing and grooming are good, but the price is absurd considering they didn't even remove the hair from inside my dog's ears.
P.S.: In response, there was no reason to stay longer and give feedback as I also have my own schedule to fulfill.
The review was indeed for this service only, but this was the score I considered in relation to the cost-benefit ratio.
This type of feedback is not complaining, after all it gives an additional view of the service, which is the objective of this type of tool.

I only trust Marley to this phenomenal team. I was so glad I found Dr. Ruben, who has a lot of patience and dedication for a patient who is anything but "easy." It has been 5 years with some concerns, but the doctor has never stopped looking for answers, no matter how difficult they may be.
The entire service is exceptional, whether in person or by phone; they have never failed to return a single call.
Thank you to the whole team!!! From Marley (Sharpei) and family.
